predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read GrabABagelTask terminations: success_bagel_02 = object_picked_up(object='bagel_02', surface='table', distance=0.05); success_bagel_01 = object_picked_up(object='bagel_01', surface='table', distance=0.05); success_bagel_07 = object_picked_up(object='bagel_07', surface='table', distance=0.05), and the helpers in conditionals.py and predicate_logic.py; RobolabEnv records success as the TerminationManager's terminated flag, the OR of every non-timeout term.

reset_and_randomization.basis: Scene breakfast_table.usda: bagel_02, bagel_01, bagel_07 among 20 contact objects. The env's only event is reset_scene_to_default and the task adds none, so every seed resets to the same authored layout; a seed varies physics only.

assets_and_frames.basis: Gripper contact (any finger body) and every box corner above the table's top face by the lift margin, with the centroid over the table's footprint.

success_timing.basis: DoneTerm success is evaluated every control step; RobolabEnv freezes the env at the first true step (a termination within its first two steps is reset as a physics artifact) and the ORA session latches it.

public_observability.basis: At reset every named object (3) projects into the over-shoulder or wrist camera with a depth reading that does not hide it (witness sha256 72420d874444).

success_witness.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 72420d874444): held_and_lifted -> True; each case from a fresh reset, objects placed by direct state edits with the robot held.

counterexamples.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 72420d874444): reset_state -> False; lifted_not_held -> False.

no_expert_strategy.basis: Clauses state end conditions only; no approach, grasp, route or motion advice.

privacy.basis: No coordinates, thresholds, fixture or object identifiers, joint values or predicate names enter the public text; numeric limits stay in this private record.

conditions.source_basis: success_bagel_02 = object_picked_up(object='bagel_02', surface='table', distance=0.05); success_bagel_01 = object_picked_up(object='bagel_01', surface='table', distance=0.05); success_bagel_07 = object_picked_up(object='bagel_07', surface='table', distance=0.05): object_grabbed (gripper contact) and object_above(table, z_margin=distance): every box corner above the table's top face by the margin, centroid over its footprint.
conditions.interpretation: Any one named object held and lifted clear of the table.
Contact force bar and lift margin withheld.

public_clauses: One bagel must be held in the gripper and lifted so that all of it is clear above the table top, still over the table; any of the three bagels counts.
The task completes while it is held: once set down or dropped, it does not count.

notes: the subtasks score a grasp only; the termination also requires the lift

witness_plan.note: each case starts from a fresh reset of seed 0; the robot holds its reset pose with the gripper open unless a case grasps; success is any official result over the case's ticks
